answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and verifies it through remote attestation. The network accepts an identity only when genuine TEE hardware proves that approved code is running, preventing a copied VM, disk image, or software key from creating another instance. Thus, cloning identities requires purchasing physical silicon and passing attestation; willow, ember, and island are only names, not additional identities.
